method: Basket v1 is the rand cost of a family Saturday fire as three kilos of meat: 1 kg boerewors, 1 kg bone-in pork loin chops, and 1 kg chicken braai pack. Wood and beer wait for a later basket. Each line is a single confirmed public guest price from Vryheid / KZN, never an estimate and never an interpolation between shops. The chicken line is the 1 kg equivalent of a confirmed 650 g braai pack (R39.00 → R60.00/kg). Product URLs are citations, not a shop. total_zar is 109.99 + 84.99 + 60.00 = 254.98.
